 Production has been suspended at Iraq's Khor Mor gas field after a drone attack struck an LPG storage tank, sparking a fire that was still raging. Workers were evacuated into shelters, while an initial assessment indicated no casualties, according to Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi. The Kurdistan region's electricity ministry reported a loss of approximately 2.8 gigawatts of power generation.
